_comment: Table anglaise de tout ce qui vient des donnees. types / categories / forms sont generes depuis PokeAPI (voir tools/build_i18n.md). labels vient de tools/.cache/pokemon_form_names.csv, la table PokeAPI dont tools/build_forms.py a tire le francais — meme source des deux cotes, donc correspondance exacte. cosmetics et games sont traduits a la main et relus. Les categories sont clees par NUMERO NATIONAL : six categories francaises couvrent plusieurs libelles anglais (« Pokemon Poisson » vaut Fish, Goldfish, Angler et Water Fish). Les formes sont clees par leur cle PokeAPI. Le reste est cle par le francais, qui est la langue source du site.

formes.Méga-Évolution en combat : fais tenir sa: Mega Evolution in battle: give the Pokémon its Mega Stone to hold and use the Mega Ring. The form lasts for the battle only.
formes.Une Méga-Évolution n'a pas de chromatiqu: A Mega Evolution has no shiny of its own: it takes the base Pokémon's. Hunt the ordinary Pokémon and the Mega follows.

formes.Il faut un individu porteur du facteur G: You need an individual with the Gigantamax factor: Max Raid Battles in the Wild Area (the dens with a red glow), or Max Soup on the Isle of Armor on a Pokémon of the species.
formes.Le chromatique se joue sur l'individu :: Shininess is decided per individual: in a raid, the shiny sparkle shows the moment you catch it. Max Soup, by contrast, adds the Gigantamax factor to a Pokémon you have already hunted — the most reliable route to a shiny Gigantamax.
formes.Forme à part entière : elle a son propre: A form in its own right: it has its own shiny, to be hunted separately from the Kanto form. notes.Starters, Pokémon offerts (Bulbizarre et: Starters, gift Pokémon (the Bulbasaur and Squirtle on the Isle of Armor, Leon's Charmander, the gift Porygon, the three Alolan starters from the Diglett hunt, Type: Null from the Battle Tower, the Toxel from the Nursery, the Slowpoke in Wedgehurst, the Poipole in Freezington), the story legendaries (Zacian, Zamazenta, Eternatus), Kubfu / Urshifu, Glastrier, Spectrier and Calyrex.
notes.Regieleki et Regidrago ne sont PAS verro: Regieleki and Regidrago are NOT locked: they are the only two Gen VIII legendaries you can shiny hunt here, by soft resetting at the Split-Decision Ruins. The legendaries of the Dynamax Adventures (the Kanto birds, the Johto beasts, the Ultra Beasts and so on) can be shiny too, at 1/300, or 1/100 with the Shiny Charm. Type: Null and Poipole, by contrast, do not breed: their shinies really are out of reach in this game.
notes.Presque rien n'est verrouillé : starters: Almost nothing is locked: starters, Dialga, Palkia, Giratina, the lake trio and the Ramanas Park legendaries can all be soft reset.
notes.Seuls les fabuleux transférés (Mew de Le: Only the transferred Mythicals (the Let's Go Mew, the Sword/Shield Jirachi) and Manaphy stay blocked.
notes.Tous les légendaires et les Pokémon liés: Every legendary and every quest-linked Pokémon: the three gift starters (Cyndaquil, Oshawott, Rowlet), the 108-spirit Spiritomb, the static Unown, the lake trio, Dialga, Palkia, Giratina, Heatran, Regigigas, Cresselia, and the four Forces of Nature.
notes.Tiplouf n'est pas verrouillé ici : il se: Piplup is not locked here: it turns up wild in the Cobalt Coastlands, mass outbreaks included. One amusing exception: the Ponyta from the request about an unusual Ponyta is a guaranteed shiny.
notes.Starters de Paldéa et Œuf de starter de: The Paldea starters and the Sinnoh starter Egg given by Jacq, the Gimmighoul line, the four Treasures of Ruin, Koraidon and Miraidon, the Paradox Pokémon, the Loyal Three, Ogerpon, Terapagos, Pecharunt — and the 25 legendaries from older generations unlocked by Snacksworth's snacks, all locked.
notes.Tout le reste est chassable : apparition: Everything else can be hunted: mass outbreaks, Sparkling Power sandwiches, and the Shiny Charm once the Pokédex is complete. The Paldea starters (906, 909, 912) are NOT on this list, and that is not an oversight: the gift specimen really is locked, but the species breeds, and the Masuda Method gives 1/512. Leaving them in made their shinies unfindable for the app — it offered no hunt at all, when the only one worth doing is precisely breeding. They are the only trio in this position: everywhere else, a starter locked in its home game stays catchable in another (the Terarium in The Indigo Disk, Let's Go, the Grand Underground in BDSP).
notes.Mewtwo et sa Méga-Évolution, le trio mét: Mewtwo and its Mega Evolution, the weather trio, Heatran, Xerneas, Yveltal, Zygarde, Meltan and Melmetal: all scripted, and none of them turns up outdoors.
notes.Liste établie sur Serebii après la sorti: Drawn up from Serebii after the game's release, and deliberately shorter than theirs. Serebii also locks Bulbasaur, Charmander, Squirtle, Chikorita, Totodile, Tepig, Absol, Lucario, Stunfisk, Flabébé and Gimmighoul — but those eleven ALSO appear wild in Lumiose: the lock is on the scripted encounter, not on the species. Locking them outright would have said “no shiny possible” where wild hunting is still open. Worth rechecking if any of them turns out to be missing from the spawns after all. The Kalos starters (650, 653, 656) have been REMOVED: the pre-release list believed they were gifts, whereas the Z-A starters are Chikorita, Tepig and Totodile.
notes.Un Pokémon offert n'est verrouillé que d: A gift Pokémon is only locked in some games — Sword/Shield, Scarlet/Violet, Legends: Arceus, Let's Go. Everywhere else (Gen II to VII, Brilliant Diamond), it can be soft reset.
notes.Un légendaire capturé dans l'intrigue es: A legendary caught during the story is nearly always locked from Gen V onwards. Before that, it can be soft reset.
notes.Les Pokémon d'échange interne (le PNJ qu: In-game trade Pokémon (the NPC who always trades the same one) have been locked in every game since Gen III.
notes.Uniquement par distribution officielle o: Only through an official distribution, or the Poké Ball Plus (Let's Go). Always shiny-locked.
notes.Distribution événementielle, ou obtenu e: An event distribution, or obtained at the end of the story in Legends: Arceus. Always shiny-locked.

ui.HOME range par numéro national : la suit: HOME sorts by National Dex number: your screenshots run in increasing order. The site first keeps only the clear-cut matches, which become anchors; then, between two anchors, a box can only be a species from that range. A thousand candidates drop to a handful, and a middling match becomes conclusive. Six passes, each one tightening the next. Any match that would break the order is thrown out, whatever its score — that's why dropping the screenshots out of order degrades the result a lot.
